how_to_read: sentences[].w = first..last word id inside this chapter; word k (0-based) of the sentence is first+k and `ar` is the spoken text (its space-separated tokens are those words); fr = [start_frame, end_frame] at 24 fps from the word map; impact = hook words (id=text); num = spoken numbers with data-contract fact ids; first_mention = glossary terms to chip (id=term); dup = same claim in another chapter. Anchor with {word, lead_frames} only. Visual candidates are ideas, never footage.

constraints.anchors: {word, lead_frames} only; never seconds or frames; event frame = word start - lead_frames
constraints.lead_frames: kinetic word -3, graphic state change -2, shot cut -4..-6 (inside a pause >= 200 ms), counter starts at the number word
constraints.density: >= 20 events/min; no gap > 4 s without an event (hold <= 6 s with reason); shot median 6-12 s, max 25 s (shots > 12 s: an event every 3 s)
constraints.coverage: every sentence >= 1 anchored event; >= 80 % of sentences a mechanism event; every spoken number and every first-mention term on screen
constraints.kinetic: 8-20 kinetic words per minute; <= 6 words and <= 2 lines on screen; impact word 1-2 words
constraints.fx: hero (real-time 3D) <= 5 % of chapter frames (ADR-002 RT5); fx_tier lite|standard|hero
constraints.text: text on busy backgrounds needs a plate or halo; sizes and safe areas: 04 sections 3.2 and 3.4
banned: invented numbers (every number: data-contract id or source sentence)
constraints.components: use only frozen components (harness/schemas/components/); requests go to corpus/specs/_component_requests.jsonl
constraints.chapter_rhythm: problem -> mental model -> progressive visual -> worked example -> prediction -> failure (crit) -> fix (ok) -> callback -> artifact (per chapter, not per sentence)

sentences.ar: أغلب data platforms شغالة على Linux، فالفرق بين إنك تخمّن وإنك تعرف في ليلة عطل هو الشابتر ده.
sentences.en: Most data platforms run on Linux, so the difference between guessing and knowing on a bad night is this chapter.

sentences.ar: الـpermissions مش حيطة، دي تلات أسئلة بتتسأل بالترتيب:
sentences.en: Permissions are not a wall, they are three questions asked in order:

sentences.ar: إنت المالك؟ إنت في الـgroup؟ ولا لا ده ولا ده؟
sentences.en: Are you the owner, are you in the group, or are you neither?

sentences.ar: الـkernel بيستشير كلاس واحد بس وبعدها يقف
sentences.en: The kernel consults exactly one of those classes and then stops

sentences.ar: وعشان كده لما تزوّد صلاحية للـgroup ساعات ما يحصلش أي حاجة خالص.
sentences.en: Which is why adding a group permission sometimes changes nothing at all.

sentences.ar: الـprocess برنامج شغال وليه ميموري خاصة وfile handles خاصة.
sentences.en: A process is a running program with its own memory and its own file handles.

sentences.ar: بتطلب منه يقف بـSIGTERM، اللي ممكن يمسكها وينضّف وراه.
sentences.en: You ask it to stop with SIGTERM, which it may handle and clean up after.

sentences.ar: وبتجبره بـSIGKILL، اللي مش قادر يمسكها وعشان كده الـkill الإجباري ممكن يسيب ملف نصّه متكتب.
sentences.en: You force it with SIGKILL, which it cannot catch — and which is why a forced kill can leave a half-written file behind.

sentences.ar: الـservices عبارة عن processes الجهاز بيديرها لك،
sentences.en: Services are processes the machine manages for you,

sentences.ar: وأهو اللي بيفرق وإنت on call: الـunit دي في crash loop، بس السبب في service بعيدة عنها بخطوتين.
sentences.en: And here is the thing that matters on call: this unit is in a crash loop, but the cause is two services upstream of it.

sentences.ar: أول سؤال on call مش إيه اللي باظ، أول سؤال إيه اللي باظ الأول.
sentences.en: The first question on call is never what broke, it is what broke first.

sentences.ar: فاقرا الـlog من تحت لفوق، ودوّر على أول سطر مش نتيجة لسطر فوقه.
sentences.en: So read the log from the bottom up and find the earliest line that is not a consequence of something above it.

sentences.ar: وخد بالك من الـdisk: الديسك المليان مش بيعلن عن نفسه، هو بس بيخلّي كل حاجة تانية تبدأ تفشل بشكل غريب.
sentences.en: And watch the disk: a full disk does not announce itself, it just makes everything else start failing strangely.

facts.rule: A number goes on screen with its fact id as `ref`/`data_refs`. `unmatched_numbers` are spoken but have no data-contract fact: their source is the sentence itself (a valid `s:` ref); never replace them with a different figure.

glossary.rule: Explain the term in Egyptian Arabic the first time it appears; then use the original term naturally, in Latin script, inside Arabic sentences.
glossary.register_ar: Natural Egyptian, clear, calm, professional. Use إحنا and خلّينا نشوف and ببساطة where they help. No heavy Modern Standard Arabic. No exaggerated slang. Numbers are spoken naturally in Egyptian but displayed as Western digits.
glossary.register_en: Plain, direct, unhurried. Short sentences. No hype, no "imagine that…", no rhetorical questions that are not real prediction prompts. Say the number, then pause for half a beat before the next sentence — the pause is where the viewer reads the screen.
glossary.never_translate_rule: Explain them in Egyptian Arabic the first time they appear, then use the original term naturally.
glossary.on_screen: Western digits, Latin terms in LTR isolates, Egyptian Arabic copy (no MSA), no per-letter animation (04 section 3.4).

concepts.def_en: An open-source operating system that runs most servers, managed through a shell, files, processes and permissions.
concepts.def_ar: نظام تشغيل مفتوح المصدر بيشغّل معظم السيرفرات، وبتتدار عن طريق shell وfiles وprocesses وpermissions.
concepts.failure: Running commands with sudo until something works, instead of understanding permissions.

concepts.def_en: The core of the operating system: it manages CPU, memory, devices and processes, and sits between programs and hardware.
concepts.def_ar: الـkernel قلب نظام التشغيل: بيدير الـCPU والـmemory والـdevices والـprocesses، وهو الوسيط بين البرامج والـhardware.
concepts.failure: Confusing the kernel with the shell or the whole operating system.

concepts.def_en: A running program instance with its own memory and process ID, managed by the operating s…
concepts.failure: Treating a program file on disk and a running process as the same thing.

concepts.def_en: A rotation in which a designated engineer is reachable to respond to alerts and incidents for a set period.
concepts.def_ar: نظام تناوب بيبقى فيه مهندس محدد متاح يرد على الـalerts والـincidents خلال فترة معينة، حتى بالليل والويك إند.
concepts.failure: Paging without a runbook or clear owner, leaving the responder to guess.

concepts.def_en: A service that starts, crashes and is restarted over and over, never staying healthy, often because of a failing dependency or bad config.
concepts.def_ar: الـcrash loop خدمة بتشتغل وتقع وتتعمل لها restart تاني وتاني من غير ما تثبت، غالبًا بسبب dependency بايظة أو config غلط.
concepts.failure: Restarting the crashing unit repeatedly instead of tracing the upstream dependency that actually fails.

concepts.def_en: A construct that repeats a block of code for each item or until a condition changes.
concepts.failure: Off-by-one bounds, or a condition that never changes, looping forever.

concepts.def_en: Persistent storage, far slower than RAM, that keeps data after power-off; when full, ever…
concepts.failure: Ignoring disk usage until it fills and unrelated services begin failing with strange erro…

components.does: One whole word (or a tatweel-joined compound like الـKafka) on screen; never split per letter.
Up to 6 kinetic words on at most 2 lines, each word arriving on its own spoken word anchor.
A technical term chip (Latin in an LTR isolate) with an optional Arabic gloss; 28 px floor if spoken.
A counter that rolls from the previous value to the target over the spoken number (preset count).
An arrow from a label to a target layer (or a named part of it, 'layer.part').
Failure beat: glitch + low thud; flashes stay <= 3/s (WCAG 2.3.1).
Fix beat: the target settles into place with a settle chime.
The shot camera: move + ease + intensity; drift always on; optional impact nudges (<= 4 px) on anchors.
Match cut between a layer of this shot and one of the next.
Lower-third caption for a source, term, speaker or location.
Draw an SVG path (stroke reveal; RTL by default for Arabic layouts).
A tree as a flat parent list: variant btree | plan | decision | fs.
A terminal (LTR isolate) whose lines appear on anchors.
Roles x resources with grant levels; locks deny or open.
Nodes sending heartbeats; a missed beat marks a node suspect.
Scrolling log lines (LTR isolate) by level.
Trunk chapter title card (riser + sting in the SFX map).
